title: MetaCoin R3 external-verifier-pilot submission
description: Honest, research-stage, ZERO-VALUE external-verifier submission. NOT consensus, NOT mainnet, NOT payment, NOT a token. A matching output_hash proves REPRODUCIBILITY (the result was independently re-derived to the same canonical value); it does NOT by itself prove the verifier executed the task (a hash can be copied).

event.description: Fixed event tag for an external-verifier submission.

topology.description: Honest topology label. This is a pilot, not decentralized consensus.

task_id.description: Reproducible task id, short or full form (e.g. 'task-0002').

verifier_id.description: Name/handle of the external verifier (ideally a separate person or org).

machine_fingerprint.description: Coarse, NON-identifying sha256 of platform string + machine arch. No hostname/user/IP; not PII.

timestamp.description: Unix epoch seconds when the submission was produced.

output_hash.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the task's canonical output, computed by the task module itself.

repo_commit.description: git rev-parse HEAD of the verifier's checkout, or 'unknown'.

environment_summary.description: Coarse, non-identifying environment summary (python version + platform/arch).

zero_value.description: Always true: nothing of value is represented or transferred.

no_token.description: Always true: no token, no payment, no wallet.

r2_attestation.description: OPTIONAL R2 software-key MAC over task_id+output_hash. Symmetric HMAC-SHA256; NOT a public-key signature; NOT hardware-backed; does NOT prove execution.

signing_note.description: Honest description of the optional MAC and its limitation.
